answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The echo graph is validated at intake and the vault frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and velvet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Running 96 accounts means paying 85 times the fee up front and waiting 7 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
